in_marathi.name: Nem
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nem हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nidra’ which means sleep, Nem signifies ignorance or sleep. In Hindu mythology, Nem is also considered a demon of ignorance. It is believed that one must overcome ignorance to attain enlightenment.
